title.zh: 费率与复利 · 1% 吃掉多少

description.zh: 基金或账户的年费按资产比例收，等于把每年的收益率从 r 降成 r − f；这个差距随复利指数式拉大：年收益 5% 放 30 年，1% 的年费会吃掉约四分之一的终值。
description.en: An annual fee charged as a share of assets lowers each year’s return from r to r − f, and compounding widens the gap exponentially: at 5% a year for 30 years, a 1% annual fee eats about a quarter of the final value.

aliases.en: how much does a 1% fee cost

label.zh: 费率改的是复利公式里的 r
label.en: A fee changes the r in the compound formula

reason.zh: 复利 A = P(1+r)ᵗ；收 f 的费就变成 P(1+r−f)ᵗ。两条指数曲线的差距不是每年固定一点，而是随 t 越拉越大。
reason.en: Compounding gives A = P(1+r)ᵗ; a fee f turns it into P(1+r−f)ᵗ. The gap between the two exponential curves is not a fixed amount per year but widens with t.

question.zh: 每年 1% 的费率，30 年下来到底吃掉多少？
question.en: What does a 1% annual fee really cost over 30 years?

ask.zh: 10000 按 5% 复利 30 年是多少？按 4% 呢？
ask.en: What do 10,000 grow to over 30 years at 5%, and at 4%?

ask.zh: 两个结果差多少？占不收费终值的几成？
ask.en: How far apart are the two, as a share of the no-fee result?

reveal.zh: 1% 的年费相当于把 5% 的年收益降成 4%：30 年后 10000 分别变成约 43200 和约 32400，差约 10800，大约是不收费终值的四分之一。
reveal.en: A 1% annual fee turns a 5% return into 4%: after 30 years 10,000 becomes about 43,200 versus about 32,400 — a gap of about 10,800, roughly a quarter of the no-fee result.
